sprint: Collection Phase 6: Creator-Side "From This World" Browsing UI (closes the 6-phase Collection plan)
task: Implements Phase 6, the final phase of the approved Collection plan -- the 'add new' half of the user's own answered 'Both' on the one open design fork, closing the loop the whole feature was built for: a Theme Author's own Collection assets, flagged availableToCreator, become something a Story Author in Creator can reach and use. js/contextPanel.js gained _activeCollectionAssets() (resolves theme.collectionAssets off the active Artwork Theme, filtered to availableToCreator===true), _showCollectionPicker() (a grid modal reusing the Add Something accordion's own context-add-grid/context-add-card visual language), and _addCollectionObject(entry) (creates an ordinary new Story-owned Decoration via SceneEngine.addSticker, exactly like Emojis/Shapes already work). _addSomethingItems() conditionally prepends a '🎁 From This World' card only when at least one availableToCreator entry exists -- hidden entirely otherwise, never a dead row. The load-bearing design decision: the new sticker's .image field holds the compiled relPath string verbatim (never re-embedded/re-uploaded), resolved LIVE at render time via ThemeRegistry.resolveAssetRef -- the same universal resolver every World-owned Decoration Layer already uses. renderer/slideRenderer.js gained a new sticker kind:'image' (the fourth new sticker capability this session after Shape/Text/Doodle, following their exact precedent) -- a dispatch branch in _drawSceneSticker/_stickerBbox plus a dedicated _drawStickerImage(st,s) drawing through the existing _ensureDecorationImage cache-and-redraw-on-load mechanism. js/cardDesigner.js's _refreshSticker gained a matching isImageKind check + 'Picture' label. css/style.css gained 6 new rules for the picker. Verified via collection_phase6_verify.js (scratch, 13/13 assertions, zero unexpected console/network errors) across two scenarios in fresh browser contexts: WITH Collection entries confirms card presence, the availableToCreator filter (2 of 3 tiles shown), correct tile labels, real resolved src, sticker creation/auto-selection with kind==='image', the .image field holding the exact compiled relPath (not re-resolved), a correctly-thumbnailed Object Strip card, a 'Picture' Selection Action Strip label, and successful delete; WITHOUT any entries confirms the card is genuinely absent. Two real test-fixture bugs (not app bugs) were found and fixed in the fixture itself: js/creationFlow.js's _themesForType reads supportedCreationTypes off the theme object not manifest; ThemeRegistry._setImported (used by boot-time _loadImported, unlike the real importPackage() UI flow) never sets theme.id=manifest.id, so a fixture written directly to localStorage needed to set it manually -- both disclosed, neither a product defect. Full regression: Collection Phases 1-5 (27/27, 28/28, 25/25, 17/17, 30/30) all pass unchanged; sticker_text_quickedit_verify.js (32/32), world_owned_delete_absent_verify.js (7/7), welcome_heading_removed_verify.js (4/4), bold_underline_strike_verify.js (20/20), bold_toggle_verify.js (22/22), verify_text_align_fidelity_fix.js, verify_text_newline_fix.js, verify_stretch_fit.js, verify_decoration_image_diagnostic.js, and verify_scene_image_externalize_fix.js all pass unchanged; both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) pass unchanged, confirming zero impact on either World Builder version's compile/validate/publish pipeline. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Creator Governing Rules change; tools/world-builder/ and tools/world-builder-v2/ are both completely untouched -- confined entirely to renderer/slideRenderer.js, js/cardDesigner.js, js/contextPanel.js, and css/style.css. This closes the entire Collection plan (all six phases). Phase 7 -- swap an existing World-owned Decoration's own art for a Collection alternate, the deferred half of the user's own answered 'Both' -- remains named but not yet scheduled.
